$comment: Coldline Task 2.8 public answer contract. Five structured decision answers: the pipeline stage one designated retrieval miss is attributed to, one stage the same evidence proves operated normally, the storage layout each supplied vector-engine profile records, and one qualified object-store emulator divergence that applies to this stack. The two attribution answers are checked against the live stage evidence using the published rule in tests/diagnostics/attribution.py; the three classifications are checked against the supplied profiles under infra/profiles/, never against outside knowledge.
title: Coldline Task 2.8 answers
description: One miss attribution and three factual classifications, from supplied evidence.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

attributed_failure_stage.description: The one pipeline stage the designated query's stage evidence isolates as the cause of the miss. Read the evidence with `poe diagnose`; the published attribution rule is in docs/student/task-2-8-contract.md.

ruled_out_stage.description: One other stage the same evidence positively proves operated normally on the target chunk. A stage that never saw the chunk is unobserved, not ruled out, and it must differ from the attributed stage.

pgvector_storage_layout.description: The storage layout the supplied profile records for PostgreSQL with pgvector, from infra/profiles/vector-engines.yaml.

qdrant_storage_layout.description: The storage layout the supplied profile records for Qdrant, from infra/profiles/vector-engines.yaml.

fidelity_limitation.description: One qualified LocalStack divergence from Amazon Web Services (AWS), from infra/profiles/object-store-fidelity.yaml. Each published code carries a reproducible local observation and an authoritative description of the AWS behavior it differs from; codes that could not be substantiated are recorded there as withdrawn, with their reason.
